Agent Name: Engineer
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The Engineer made a critical off-by-one error in the loop range of the sliding window algorithm. The loop was initialized as `for i in range(1, n - k + 1)`, which starts checking from the second window (index 1) but fails to properly handle the initial window calculation in the loop body. More importantly, the logic inside the loop uses `nums[i + k - 1]` to add the new element, but when `i=1`, this correctly adds `nums[k]`. However, the initial `current_sum` is calculated correctly before the loop, but the loop range should actually be `range(k, n)` to properly slide the window by removing `nums[i-1]` and adding `nums[i]`. The current implementation has a subtle bug where the loop variable `i` represents the index of the element being added, but the range calculation `n - k + 1` is incorrect. The correct range should be `range(k, n)` to iterate through all possible end positions of the window. This causes the algorithm to miss checking some windows or check incorrect windows, leading to potentially wrong results.
